ideas.text: An AI that bans 'boil the ocean' from your documents and makes you describe what you actually mean.
A bot that detects 'synergy' and asks everyone in the room to define it without using other jargon.
An app that converts 'move the needle' into a statement about what the needle is and where it needs to go.
A tool that counts how many times 'bandwidth' is used in a meeting and compares it to how many times work is discussed.
An AI that replaces 'circle back' with a specific date and time every single time it appears.
A bot that detects 'we need to be more strategic' and asks who 'we' is and what strategic means here specifically.
An app that converts your deck into plain English and sends both versions to the client so they can choose.
A tool that counts 'alignment' per meeting and calculates the average minutes spent aligning versus deciding.
An AI that translates 'ideate' into 'think of ideas' every time it appears in a document.
A bot that blocks 'leverage' unless it's being used about a lever, a loan, or an actual force multiplier.
An app that detects when an email is 60% filler phrasing and offers to condense it to 3 sentences.
A tool that tracks how many times your team used 'pivot' this quarter and correlates it with actual product changes.
An AI that replaces 'learnings' with 'things we learned' and 'outcomes' with 'results' company-wide.
A bot that detects 'at the end of the day' in meetings and reminds the speaker that it's 10am.
An app that requires anyone saying 'low-hanging fruit' to identify one piece and pick it before the meeting ends.
A tool that detects when a deck uses 'robust' 14 times and asks what is actually being described.
An AI that converts 'we're customer-obsessed' into a test: name the top 3 customer complaints from last month.
A bot that detects 'it is what it is' and responds with a demand for at least one thing that could change.
An app that interrupts any sentence containing both 'disruption' and 'ecosystem' and asks for a cooling-off period.
A tool that replaces 'let's take this offline' with 'I don't want to discuss this in front of everyone.'
An AI that detects 'we need to be more agile' from someone who has never attended a sprint.
A bot that converts 'soup to nuts' into a project plan with actual steps.
An app that logs every time 'holistic approach' is promised and checks whether it was delivered.
A tool that detects when 'fail fast' is used to describe something that failed slowly and expensively.
An AI that bans 'move the needle' for teams that have never defined what the needle is measuring.
A bot that detects 'not in my wheelhouse' and determines whether the speaker's wheelhouse has been updated since 2015.
An app that intercepts 'let's socialize this idea' and asks whether the idea is ready to meet people yet.
A tool that detects when 'north star' is used in 3 different decks with 3 different definitions.
An AI that converts every use of 'solution' into a description of the actual thing being sold.
A bot that flags 'best practice' and demands a citation every time it appears in a presentation.
An app that replaces 'thought leader' with 'person who has opinions and posts about them.'
A tool that detects when someone says 'peel back the layers' and asks which layer, specifically, they'd like to peel.
An AI that converts your mission statement into one sentence a 10-year-old could understand and checks if it still makes sense.
A bot that detects 'paradigm shift' and checks whether the paradigm has actually shifted or just wobbled slightly.
An app that tracks all uses of 'ecosystem' and maps whether the things in your ecosystem are actually interdependent.
A tool that replaces 'deep dive' with 'looking at this more closely' and 'surface level' with 'briefly.'
An AI that detects 'we need to be more data-driven' from someone who hasn't opened a dashboard since last quarter.
A bot that converts 'value-add' into a description of the specific value being added and who benefits from it.
An app that detects 'this is a forcing function' and asks what it's forcing and who decided that was the right force.
A tool that tracks how many times 'scalable' is promised in planning and how many times the thing actually scales.
An AI that translates '10x thinking' into what the person is actually proposing and checks if it's 10x anything.
A bot that detects when a sentence could be deleted without changing the meaning of the paragraph and deletes it.
An app that replaces 'empowerment' with a description of what the person is actually now allowed to do.
A tool that detects 'we need to be intentional' and asks what intention means in this context, operationally.
An AI that converts every instance of 'optimize for' into 'make better at' followed by a measurable outcome.
A bot that blocks 'disruptive' in pitch decks unless the presenter can identify what specifically is being disrupted.
An app that detects when a strategy document is 70% filler and collapses it into a single page without anyone noticing.
A tool that counts 'going forward' per document and suggests the writer use tense instead.
An AI that translates 'cross-functional alignment' into a list of the specific people who need to agree on what.
A bot that converts every passive construction in a business email into an active one so accountability is visible.
An app that detects when 'innovation' is being used to describe process changes that should have happened in 2018.
A tool that tracks how many of this quarter's 'strategic priorities' are the same as last quarter's 'strategic priorities.'
An AI that detects when a slide has a word count higher than a word count that warrants a slide.
A bot that intercepts 'we're all in this together' and runs a quick headcount to verify the claim.
An app that converts 'we need to have a conversation about this' into a scheduled meeting with a specific agenda.
